name: io.github.Jaketdaniels/tariff-watch
title: tariff.watch
description: Source-linked changelog of US tariff, customs, and trade actions from the Federal Register (public domain): legal status, effective dates, comment deadlines, and an immutable dated archive. Tool discovery is free; tool calls use an API key from https://tariff.watch (first 30 calls free, then US$0.10/call).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key from https://tariff.watch/#plans — required for tools/call, not for discovery.
